description: This file defines the implementation of the EquationViewModel class and related classes for the graphing calculator feature in the Calculator app. It manages graph features, error handling, and resource localization.

classes.name: GridDisplayItems
classes.description: Represents a display item with an expression and direction, used in graph feature listings.

classes.name: KeyGraphFeaturesItem
classes.description: Represents a key feature of a graph, including title, display items, and whether the display is text.

classes.name: EquationViewModel
classes.description: Main view model class for managing equation graph features, errors, and resource localization.

methods.name: EquationViewModel::PopulateKeyGraphFeatures
methods.description: Populates the key graph features list based on the provided graph equation info, handling errors and adding features.

methods.name: EquationViewModel::AddKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds a key graph feature with a single expression or error message to the list.

methods.name: EquationViewModel::AddKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds a key graph feature with multiple expressions or an error message to the list.

methods.name: EquationViewModel::AddParityKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds parity information as a key feature.

methods.name: EquationViewModel::AddPeriodicityKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds periodicity information as a key feature, handling unsupported or complex cases.

methods.name: EquationViewModel::AddMonotoncityKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds monotonicity information, including direction and key expressions.

methods.name: EquationViewModel::AddTooComplexKeyGraphFeature
methods.description: Adds a feature indicating too complex features, listing specific features that are too complex.

methods.name: EquationViewModel::EquationErrorText
methods.description: Returns localized error message text based on error type and code.
